title: Comprehensive Workflow for Extracting High-Quality Bacterial DNA from Milk Samples
author: Panagiota STATHOPOULOU
materials: Carefully decant the supernatant without disturbing the pellet.

steps.title: Prepare CTAB Lysis Buffer
steps.instruction: Dissolve 2 g CTAB, 8.18 g NaCl (final 1.4 M), 10 mL 1 M Tris‑HCl (pH 8, final 100 mM), and 4 mL 0.5 M EDTA (pH 8, final 20 mM) in nuclease‑free water, adjust the volume to 100 mL, and warm to 65 °C before use to fully dissolve the CTAB.

steps.title: Collect and Centrifuge Milk
steps.instruction: Transfer 10–40 mL milk into a 50 mL centrifuge tube and centrifuge at 10,000 × g, 4 °C for 15 min to pellet bacterial and somatic cells.

steps.title: Separate Fractions & Resuspend Pellet
steps.instruction: After centrifugation three layers appear: fat (top), skim milk (middle), cell pellet (bottom). Choose one of the following paths:

substeps.instruction: Option A – Pellet Only: Discard the fat layer and skim‑milk supernatant, then resuspend the pellet in 5–10 mL sterile PBS.

Option B – Pellet + Fat: Transfer the fat layer to a clean 50 mL tube with a sterile spatula, discard the skim‑milk supernatant, resuspend the pellet in 1–2 mL sterile PBS, combine with the fat layer, add 5–10 mL sterile PBS containing 0.1 % Tween‑20, vortex thoroughly, centrifuge at 10,000 × g for 10 min, discard the supernatant, wash the pellet once with plain PBS, centrifuge again and discard the supernatant. The resulting pellet proceeds to the next step.

steps.title: Break Down Protein Matrix
steps.instruction: Resuspend the washed pellet in 1 mL of 50–100 mM EDTA (pH 8).

steps.title: Incubate EDTA Suspension
steps.instruction: Incubate at room temperature for 10 min to allow casein micelles to dissolve, then centrifuge at >12,000 × g for 5 min at room temperature and discard the supernatant.

steps.title: Lysozyme Treatment
steps.instruction: Prepare a 20 mg/mL lysozyme solution in the kit’s Lysozyme Reaction Buffer. Resuspend the pellet in 200 µL of this lysozyme solution, incubate at 37 °C for 1 h with occasional mixing. Add 4 µL RNase A, vortex briefly, and incubate at room temperature for 10 min.

steps.title: CTAB Lysis & Proteinase K Digestion
steps.instruction: Add 500 µL pre‑warmed (65 °C) CTAB Lysis Buffer and 20 µL reconstituted Proteinase K (RBC MagCore kit) to the lysozyme‑treated sample, vortex briefly, and incubate at 65 °C for 1–2 h, inverting the tube every 20–30 min. After incubation centrifuge at >13,000 × g for 5 min at room temperature and keep the clear supernatant.

steps.title: Transfer Magnetic Beads
steps.instruction: Using a clean pipette tip, move the magnetic beads from the ‘Beads Mixture’ well (Well 9) of the MagCore cartridge into the lysate well (Well 11). Pipette the clear supernatant from the previous step into the Lysis Buffer well (Well 11) of the pre‑filled cartridge, avoiding any debris. Place the cartridge in the MagCore® instrument and run the standard pre‑programmed Bacterial DNA extraction protocol (ID 502). The instrument will automatically perform binding, washing, and elution.

steps.title: Retrieve Purified DNA
steps.instruction: When the run finishes, remove the elution tube containing purified bacterial DNA and store it at –20 °C or below.

steps.title: Phenol‑Chloroform Extraction
steps.instruction: In a fume hood with PPE, cool the lysate to room temperature, add an equal volume (~700 µL) of phenol:chloroform:isoamyl alcohol (25:24:1), vortex 10 s, centrifuge at 14,000 × g for 10 min, and transfer the upper aqueous phase to a new sterile microcentrifuge tube without disturbing the interphase. Repeat the phenol:chloroform extraction until the interphase is clean and white.

steps.title: Isopropanol DNA Precipitation
steps.instruction: Add 0.7 volumes of ice‑cold isopropanol to the final aqueous phase (e.g., 350 µL to 500 µL), mix gently by inverting, incubate at –20 °C for at least 30 min (optional overnight), then centrifuge at 14,000 × g, 4 °C for 15 min to pellet DNA.

steps.title: Ethanol Wash of DNA Pellet
steps.instruction: Add 500 µL ice‑cold 70 % ethanol, centrifuge at 14,000 × g, 4 °C for 6 min, decant the ethanol, and repeat the 70 % ethanol wash once more for higher purity.

steps.title: Dry and Resuspend DNA
steps.instruction: Remove residual ethanol with a pipette, air‑dry the pellet for 5–10 min at room temperature (do not over‑dry), then resuspend in 30–50 µL TE buffer or nuclease‑free water. If needed, warm at 65 °C for 10 min to aid dissolution. Store the DNA at –20 °C.
